name: newspapper
description: A web app for writing Instagram-style news posts by hand in .wzd markup and exporting them as 1080×1080 JPEGs with a caption.

scripts.build: npm run format:check && npm run build --workspace=core && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=ui && npm run build --workspace=ui
scripts.gate: npm run check && npm run build && bash corpus/lint.sh
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core --noEmit && tsc -p api --noEmit && tsc -p e2e --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @newspapper/ui
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:conventions && CI=1 vitest run
scripts.check:conventions: knip && depcruise core/src api/src ui/src && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-base-ui.mjs && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-structure.mjs
